units.source_text: 当时我同参加红叶节的人们在梅园抚松庵一起吃午饭，

en.t: At the time, I was having lunch at Bushuan in the plum garden with the people who had taken part in the Maple Festival,

units.source_text: 正品尝火鸡寿喜烧的时候，我妻子挂来电话，

en.t: and just as I was tasting turkey sukiyaki, my wife called,

units.source_text: 转告了遗属的话：希望我能给名人的遗容拍张照片。

en.t: passing on a message from the bereaved family: they hoped I could take a photograph of the master's face after death.

units.source_text: 那天早晨，我去瞻仰了名人的遗容，

en.t: That morning, I had gone to pay my respects before the master's remains,

units.source_text: 回家以后灵机一动，便托随后前去吊唁的妻子捎了个口信：

en.t: and after returning home, an idea came to me, so I asked my wife, who was going later to offer condolences, to carry a message:

units.source_text: 倘若遗属希望用石膏拓下死者的面型，

en.t: if the bereaved family wanted to take a plaster cast of the dead man's face,

units.source_text: 或者拍下死者的遗容，我也会欣然应承。

en.t: or to photograph his face after death, I would gladly agree to do it.

units.source_text: 名人的遗孀表示她不喜欢石膏面型，想拜托我给拍张照片。

en.t: The master's widow said she did not like the idea of a plaster face cast and wanted to ask me to take a photograph instead.
